Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you were
involved in on the road in Pearland, Texas. Please sttae your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you my first name and keep the rest private for now.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were driving and what happened?
A: I was heading down a two-lane road, going maybe twenty-five miles an hour. A car came over into my lane and we
hit nose to nose. It wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to jolt me forward and then back.
Q: Did you have time to brake before the impact?
A: Yes, I hit the brakes as soon as I saw the car drifting toward me. I didn't have much room to get out of the way.
Q: Were you able to drive your vehicle away from the scene?
A: No, the front end was pushed in and the airbags didn't deploy, so a tow truck took it. I got a ride home from my
neighbor.
Q: Did you seek medical attention afterward?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same afternoon. My neck was sore and stiff, and I had a headache that lasted a
couple of days. They diagnosed a neck strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to a physical therapist.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes, turning my head to the left is still painful, and sitting at a desk for long stretches makes it worse. I'm doing the
exercises the therapist gave me.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I want my claim handled fairly, and I'll keep you updated on my treatment.
Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
